local: Os heróis do quatro de Fevereiro.
Ó Pátria, nós saudamos os teus filhos
english: Oh Fatherland, we shall never forget
The heroes of the Fourth of February.
Oh Fatherland, we salute your children

local: Honramos o passado e a nossa História,
Construindo no Trabalho o Homem novo.
english: We honour the past and our History,
As by our work we build the New Man.
Revolution through the power of the People:

local: Um só povo, uma só Nação!
english: Let us raise our liberated voices
For the glory of the peoples of Africa.

local: Com as forças progressistas do mundo.
english: We shall fight proudly for Peace
Along with the progressive forces of the world.
